goals: Verify that the MSAL authentication configuration object is properly defined and sanitized to prevent credential leakage
Verify that the application server correctly serves the static HTML pages and includes valid MSAL CDN links
activities: Set the global document HTML to the 'index.html' content
Verify the 'src' attribute of the 'load-msal' element contains the valid CDN link
Load the MSAL configuration object into the global scope
Verify the MSAL configuration object is defined
Verify the client ID in the configuration does not match a GUID regex
Verify the authority in the configuration matches a URI regex
Set the Node environment variable to 'test'
Send a GET request to the root ('/') endpoint
Verify the response status code is 200
Verify the response text matches the 'index.html' file content
Send a GET request to the '/signout' endpoint
Verify the response status code is 200
Verify the response text matches the 'signout.html' file content
